name: demo-filesystem
description: Read/write files inside a sandboxed demo workspace. Try: 'List the files in the demo workspace' or 'Show me the runbook for coverage degradation'.

name: demo-fetch
description: Fetch arbitrary public HTTP/HTTPS URLs and return the content. Useful for pulling vendor docs, 3GPP specs, or news during an incident.

name: demo-memory
description: Persistent key/value memory across chat sessions. Try: 'Remember that USID 9787 has a known tilt issue from last quarter' — then in a new session, 'What do you know about USID 9787?'

name: demo-sequential-thinking
description: Lets the agent break a hard problem into explicit, revisable thinking steps. Good for showing reasoning during deep RCA investigations.

name: demo-everything
description: Anthropic's official reference MCP server. Exposes test tools, sample resources, and prompts — perfect for proving discovery works without any real-world side effects.
